sentences.en: The New Testament is the fulfillment of the Old Testament.
He never felt a spiritual fulfillment in the mosque.
sentences.zh: 他在清真寺里从未感受到精神上的满足。

sentences.en: Tom gets a sense of fulfillment when he reaches one of his goals.
sentences.zh: 汤姆在达成一个目标时会感到一种成就感。

senses.zh: 满足，实现；履行，执行；成就感，满足感
